summary:
Kalmykia is an autonomous republic of the Russian Federation and stands under the national framework. The national layer carries the ban on legal gender recognition and gender-affirming care, the propaganda statutes, the extremist designation of the LGBT movement, and the absence of anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection; those are recorded on the parent record and are not restated here.

Region-specific signal: no Kalmykia-specific enforcement incidents, local ordinances, or regional institutions governing trans people were identified in the source inventory. The assessment for Kalmykia therefore rests on the national framework as applied within the republic.

On the European LGBTI legal and policy index, Russia including Kalmykia scored 2% for 2024-2026, ranking joint-lowest alongside Azerbaijan.
tangentialFactors: The source inventory for Kalmykia reproduces national-level material, including the November 2023 Supreme Court designation of the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist, which makes public display of LGBT symbols, advocacy, organization, participation and funding punishable under extremism law by fines, detention and criminal imprisonment. This applies in Kalmykia as everywhere in Russia but is carried by the parent record.
localsOnly: No Kalmykia-specific resident-facing facts, local institutions, or regional practice governing trans residents were identified in the source inventory.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether Kalmykia's regional authorities have brought extremism or propaganda cases, conducted venue raids, or issued local directives concerning trans people is unresolved; the inventory contains no Kalmykia-specific enforcement data. Regional court activity under the national extremist designation is likewise not sourced here.
